sectionsPreview.summary: Describes the flocks of birds pelting the invaders with small, decreed stones of baked clay.

sectionsPreview.title: Reducing the Invaders to Devoured Chaff
sectionsPreview.summary: Depicts the utter annihilation of Abraha's army, leaving them crushed like straw chewed up by cattle.

surahs.thematicSummary: Calling the Quraysh to gratitude for divine preservation of their seasonal winter and summer trade caravans, commanding worship of the Lord of this Sacred House.

sectionsPreview.title: Blessing of Protection and Familiarity for Quraysh
sectionsPreview.summary: Reminds the tribe of Quraysh of Allah's favor in granting them safety, prestige, and peaceful unity.

sectionsPreview.title: Security of the Winter and Summer Trade Journeys
sectionsPreview.summary: Highlights the blessing of safe winter trade journeys to Yemen and summer trade journeys to Syria.

sectionsPreview.title: Command to Worship the Lord of the Ka'bah
sectionsPreview.summary: Enjoins the Quraysh to worship the Lord of the Sacred House in gratitude for their protection.

sectionsPreview.title: Divine Provision Against Hunger and Security From Fear
sectionsPreview.summary: Reminds them that Allah fed them in a barren valley against hunger and secured them from fear.

surahs.thematicSummary: Exposing the false religionist: repulsing orphans, failing to urge feeding the poor, heedless prayer performed for ostentation, and withholding basic neighboring kindnesses.

sectionsPreview.title: Denial of Judgment, Mistreating Orphans, and Ostentatious Prayer
sectionsPreview.summary: Condemns those who belie the Requital by repulsing orphans, neglecting the poor, praying ostentatiously, and withholding small kindnesses.

surahs.thematicSummary: Divine solace bestowing the Heavenly Pool of Abundance (Al-Kawthar) upon the Prophet, commanding sacrificial devotion, and declaring his hostile mocker cut off from posterity.

sectionsPreview.title: Gift of Abundance, Sacrifice, and Ruin of Enemies
sectionsPreview.summary: Announces the gift of Al-Kawthar to the Prophet, commands prayer and sacrifice, and declares his enemies cut off.

surahs.thematicSummary: The decisive proclamation of theological uncompromising clarity: 'I worship not what you worship... Unto you is your moral path, and unto me is my religion.'

sectionsPreview.title: Uncompromising Disavowal of Polytheism and Pure Monotheism
sectionsPreview.summary: Commands proclaiming total separation from idol worship in present and future, affirming pure devotion to Islam.

surahs.thematicSummary: The final complete surah revealed: the arrival of divine aid and victory, people entering the faith in multitudes, and concluding in praise and seeking forgiveness.

sectionsPreview.title: Divine Victory, Multitudes Embracing Islam, and Seeking Forgiveness
sectionsPreview.summary: Instructs the Prophet to glorify Allah and seek forgiveness when victory comes and people enter Islam in multitudes.

surahs.thematicSummary: The historic ruin of Abu Lahab and his wife's active malice against the Prophet, warning of the futility of wealth and lineage against divine justice.

sectionsPreview.title: Ruin of Abu Lahab and Futility of Wealth
sectionsPreview.summary: Proclaims the destruction of the Prophet's hostile uncle Abu Lahab and the uselessness of his wealth and gains.

sectionsPreview.title: Abu Lahab's Entry Into the Blazing Fire
sectionsPreview.summary: Foretells that Abu Lahab will certainly enter and burn in a fiercely flaming Fire.

sectionsPreview.title: Condemnation of His Wife Carrying Thorny Firewood
sectionsPreview.summary: Condemns Abu Lahab's wife Umm Jamil, who spread slander and thorns, to share his fiery punishment.

sectionsPreview.title: The Twisted Rope Around Her Neck in Hell
sectionsPreview.summary: Describes a tightly twisted rope of palm-fiber or iron collar fastened around her neck in torment.

surahs.thematicSummary: Equal to one-third of the Quran; absolute definition of pure Tawhid: Allah is One, the Eternal Refuge, Unbegotten and Unbegetting.

sectionsPreview.title: Declaration of Allah's Absolute Oneness and Self-Sufficiency
sectionsPreview.summary: Proclaims pure monotheism: Allah is One, the Eternal Refuge, neither begetting nor begotten, with none comparable to Him.

surahs.thematicSummary: Seeking refuge with the Lord of daybreak from external perils: the darkness of night, secret witchcraft blowers, and malignant envy.

sectionsPreview.title: Seeking Refuge in the Lord of Daybreak
sectionsPreview.summary: Teaches seeking Allah's protection from created evils, encroaching darkness, sorcerers blowing on knots, and destructive envy.

surahs.thematicSummary: Seeking refuge with the Sovereign King and God of humanity from the stealthy internal whisperer (Al-Waswas Al-Khannas).

sectionsPreview.title: Seeking Refuge From the Insidious Whisperer's Malice
sectionsPreview.summary: Invokes the Lord, King, and God of mankind for protection against the retreating whisperer among jinn and men.
